rows.grounds: relative pronoun referring to the one for whom proper observance becomes possible
indeclinable indicating completeness or correctness of observance
demonstrative pronoun referring back to the qualified person
gerundive expressing obligation to perform the act
instrumental agent; samayin denotes the first grade of initiate

items.question: Which initiate is obligated to perform worship when proper observance becomes possible?
premises: Proper observance may become possible for a given person.
That person is identified as a samayin initiate.
Worship is prescribed as an obligatory act.
items.inference: A samayin for whom proper observance becomes possible must perform the worship.
uncertainties: The precise scope of the worship referred to depends on the preceding verses' context of compensatory observance.
items.plain_english: When proper observance becomes possible for someone, that samayin should perform the worship.
